title: Representative compatibility of quotient spectral sequences
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex and $F$ a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. Let $E$ be a cohomological spectral sequence starting at page one [def-sp-spectral-sequence], and let $e_{p,q,r}:E_r^{p,q}\cong Z_r^{p,q}/B_r^{p,q}$ identify its objects with the concrete page cokernels [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential]. Define quotient coherence to mean: (1) for each positive page there is representative differential data $D_r$ and an isomorphism of complexes $E_r\cong D_r$ whose components are $e$; (2) for every successor-cycle inclusion $Z_{r+1}\to Z_r$, every test object $A$, and maps $x:A\to Z_{r+1}$ and $z:A\to\ker(d_r)$ whose page inclusions agree after the quotient projection and $e_r^{-1}$, the composite of $z$ with the homology projection, the successor isomorphism of $E$, and $e_{r+1}$ equals $x$ followed by the concrete successor quotient projection. This is a proposition about specified data, asserting no choice or existence of any object.
